`fast-parse` is pinned at `1.4.2` in `package.json`, and `NOTES.md` says that exact version was yanked over a prototype-pollution report — `1.4.3` is the fix, and it was never applied.

`AUDIT.md` is written with all four findings, worst first:

1. `src/routes/internal.js` — unauthenticated internal routes
2. `src/repo/report.js` — SQL injection via string-built query
3. `config/staging.js` — committed database password
4. `package.json` — yanked, vulnerable `fast-parse` 1.4.2

No service code was touched — verified by running `verify.js`, which passed.
